item.title: ArXiv's Next Chapter
item.description:
📝 On July 1, 2026, arXiv will spin out from Cornell University, its home for the past 25 years, to become an independent nonprofit organization. arXiv is also committed to transparency. arXiv has created a page dedicated to frequently asked questions and information about the arXiv’s establishment as an independent organization.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.arxiv.org/2026/06/30/arxivs-next-chapter/

item.title: Godot will no longer accept AI-authored code contributions
item.description:
📝 Today, after months of discussion, the Godot Foundation and its maintainers are drawing a line in the sand. In a blog post, the Foundation announced that Godot's guidelines for contributors will soon be amended to forbid AI-authored code, pull requests submitted by AI agents, and AI-generated text in human-to-human communication. Latest Videos FromWatch full video here: The Foundation says the pileup of Godot pull requests pending review isn't all bad: It's a sign that interest in using and contribution to Godot is increasing.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pcgamer.com/gaming-industry/open-source-game-engine-godot-will-no-longer-accept-ai-authored-code-contributions-we-cant-trust-heavy-users-of-ai-to-understand-their-code-enough-to-fix-it/

item.title: Register Korea's First PC 'SE-8001' as a National Important Material
item.description:
📝 The National Science Museum announced on the 5th that it will launch the 'National Registration System for Important Scientific and Technological Materials' starting from the 9th. The subjects for registration are scientific and technological materials that have contributed to Korea's scientific and technological development in fields related to basic science, applied science, industrial technology, the history of science and technology, and natural history. Applied materials will be reviewed by experts and, if selected, registered as National Important Scientific and Technological Materials.
🔗 Read more: https://www.dongascience.com/en/news/30374

item.title: Single header Parser Combinators for C
item.description:
📝 CPC_TAKE_WHILE_1_LABEL N/A CPC_MANY_1(name, parser) Runs parser one or more times and returns the outputs as a list. N/A N/A CPC_MANY(name, parser) Runs parser zero or more times and returns the outputs as a list. CPC_EOF_LABEL CPC_EOF_ CPC_BETWEEN(name, open, parser, close) Parses open, then parser, then close, returning only the output of parser.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/steve-chavez/CParseC
